publicCopy.titleZh: 印度初创公司 HrdWyr 开发面向实体世界的 AI 原生 SoC
publicCopy.titleEn: Indian startup HrdWyr is developing AI-native SoCs for physical-world systems
publicCopy.summaryZh: EE Times 报道，印度初创公司 HrdWyr 正在开发面向电源管理、电机控制及其他实体系统应用的 AI 原生 SoC。报道介绍了产品方向，但未披露商业化部署、量产规模或数据中心出货。
publicCopy.summaryEn: EE Times reports that Indian startup HrdWyr is developing AI-native SoCs for power management, motor control and other physical-system applications. The report describes the product direction but does not disclose commercial deployment, production scale or data-center shipments.

publicCopy.titleZh: CoWoS 2027 年产能据报已订满，部分客户评估英特尔 EMIB-T
publicCopy.titleEn: TSMC 2027 CoWoS capacity is reportedly fully booked as some customers assess Intel EMIB-T
publicCopy.summaryZh: IT之家转述韩国《朝鲜日报》称，台积电 CoWoS 先进封装的 2027 年产能配额据报已被预订，部分客户正在评估英特尔 EMIB-T。报道提到联发科、博通、Meta、谷歌、英伟达和 SK 海力士的相关评估或采用，但这些产能与客户动向尚未获相关公司或台积电公开确认。
publicCopy.summaryEn: IT Home, citing South Korea Chosun, reports that TSMC 2027 CoWoS allocation is fully booked and that some customers are assessing Intel EMIB-T. The report names MediaTek, Broadcom, Meta, Google, NVIDIA and SK hynix, but the reported capacity and customer moves have not been publicly confirmed by the companies or TSMC.

publicCopy.titleZh: 《财富》：特朗普以强硬措辞谈数据中心反对者，共和党内部仍有分歧
publicCopy.titleEn: Fortune reports Trump attacked data-center opponents as Republican divisions persist
publicCopy.summaryZh: 《财富》报道称，特朗普在谈及数据中心反对者与美国经济、选举政治时使用了“落后且贫穷”等措辞；文章同时描述共和党内部对数据中心扩张的分歧。该报道记录的是政治表态与报道语境，不等于新的联邦规则或项目许可。
publicCopy.summaryEn: Fortune reports that Trump used phrases including backwards and poor when discussing data-center opponents, while describing divisions within the Republican Party over data-center expansion. The report records political statements and context; it is not a new federal rule or project permit.
